kite.comment: Direct HTTP gets a Cloudflare 403, so the mcp-remote bridge is required. mcp-remote needs Node >= 20.18.1 (see .nvmrc), so make sure `npx` resolves to a recent Node.

wallet.comment: Plain streamable HTTP with the access token from the Wallet app (Settings, MCP). Paste the WHOLE token: export WALLET_MCP_TOKEN=<token> in the terminal, then start `claude` from this folder. A truncated token is rejected with HTTP 401.

indmoney.comment: Returns 401 with OAuth 2.1 + PKCE discovery metadata; Claude Code handles the flow natively.

groww.comment: Groww's official hosted MCP server (stocks and F&O only; mutual funds are not supported yet). Sign-in is a browser link. If Claude Code's native OAuth does not complete, replace this entry with the bridge Groww documents for other clients: command npx, args [-y, mcp-remote, https://mcp.groww.in/mcp, 52155] (needs Node >= 20.18.1). IT EXPOSES ORDER TOOLS and their names are not published: fingod only ever calls read tools. After connecting, list the tools and deny the order ones in .claude/settings.json (see docs/ONBOARDING.md).
